Bought the tool, nothing more

“All the hard work is in process documentation and data architecture.” Executive, telecom company

If the organisation is the constraint, we should ask what specifically got in the way. Across fifty-one successful cases, seventy-seven per cent of the hardest challenges were not technical. They were change management, data quality and process redesign. Technology was described as the easiest part. An executive put it bluntly: all the hard work sits in process documentation and data architecture.

Now the measured counterpart, on a hundred and seventeen thousand firms. Sixty-four per cent of firms using AI made no institutional adjustment of any kind. They bought the tool and changed nothing around it. Training and new workflows reached only about fifteen per cent.
